comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Prosperity of Ancient Egypt Memorial Album, this is created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Anchor
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 250

Ingredients:
The Sun's Gemstone x1
Ankh of Anubis x1
Aqua Concentrate x10
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not.

Note: unfortunately, the base item (Anchor) was only made available for a limited time in the UWC cove/captain's ticket. As such it may be very difficult to locate one for your own use. Cheers, and best wishes in that regard.
